sources.note: Aurora Education Foundation Indigenous Pathways Portal scholarship details page for the Roberta Sykes Scholarship, on the awarding body's own domain.

awarding_body.detail: The page is the Aurora Education Foundation's own scholarship-details page (aurorafoundation.com.au). It states the scholarship is administered by Aurora and jointly funded with the Australian Government (National Indigenous Australians Agency), the British High Commission (Chevening), Cambridge Australia Scholarships Ltd, Cambridge Commonwealth Trust and the University of Cambridge.
awarding_body.quote: Roberta Sykes Scholarships are administered by the Aurora Education Foundation and jonintly funded by the Australian Government (National Indigenous Australians Agency), the British High Commission (Chevening), Cambridge Australia Scholarships Ltd, Cambridge Commonwealth Trust and the University of Cambridge.

deadline.detail: The page shows the current cycle open since 5 October 2026 with a closing date of 29 January 2027, matching the record's deadline of 29 January 2027. The cycle is open today (12 October 2026).

eligibility.detail: Confirmed all record claims: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students only; full-time study; at any recognised overseas university; any area of study; doctoral research, postgraduate coursework or postgraduate research level; academic excellence plus commitment to improving outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities. The page additionally requires written confirmation of Aboriginal/Torres Strait Islander identity from an incorporated Indigenous organisation or Land Council.
eligibility.quote: Open to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Students Only ... Areas of study: Any Area of Study ... Study Level: Doctoral Research, Postgraduate Coursework, Postgraduate Research ... Study Load: Full Time ... Location: Overseas

funding.detail: The record's 'Partially Funded' classification is supported: the page describes the scholarship as supplementary financial assistance, up to a maximum of AUD $75,000 paid directly to the recipient in equal instalments each semester or term, subject to academic progress. It is not a fully funded award; the value depends on the applicant's budget and other funding.
funding.quote: The Roberta Sykes Scholarship provides supplementary financial assistance to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander postgraduate students ... The value of the Scholarship is up to a maximum amount of AUD $75,000, paid directly to the recipient in equal instalments at the start of each semester or term, subject to academic progress.

degree_levels.detail: The page lists exactly the levels in the record: Doctoral Research, Postgraduate Coursework, Postgraduate Research.
degree_levels.quote: Study Level: Doctoral Research, Postgraduate Coursework, Postgraduate Research

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Verified live on 2026-10-12 against the Aurora Education Foundation Indigenous Pathways Portal page; cycle open 05/10/2026 - 29/01/2027. Award is supplementary (partial), up to AUD $75,000 total, paid in semester/term instalments; the catalogue funding_type 'Partially Funded' is correct. Applicants need Confirmation of Aboriginality (common seal, Land Council or incorporated organisation) plus a budget. Page is a Power Apps portal whose content renders client-side; if a future fetch returns only an offline-shell page, retry or use the Scholarship Search listing rather than treating the link as dead.
